cards.card_text: Pomegranates made of yarn go all the way around the robe's lower hem.
cards.verse_text: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,
cards.snippet: …of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,

cards.card_text: Gold bells and pomegranates take turns all the way around the hem, and Aaron has to wear this robe whenever he ministers.
cards.verse_text: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
cards.snippet: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.

cards.card_text: Down at the lower hem, they make pomegranates out of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen.
cards.verse_text: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
cards.snippet: …blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.

cards.card_text: Between the yarn pomegranates on the hem, they hang ___ of pure gold.
cards.verse_text: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,
cards.snippet: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,

cards.card_text: Bell, pomegranate, bell, pomegranate, all the way around the hem, and somewhere Mags is SO proud.
cards.verse_text: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
cards.snippet: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD…

cards.card_text: As Samuel turns to go, Saul grabs the hem of his robe.
cards.verse_text: “For you have rejected the word of the LORD, and He has rejected you as king over Israel.” As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the hem of his robe, and it tore.
cards.snippet: …as king over Israel.” As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the hem of his robe, and it tore.

cards.card_text: The wicked hem in the righteous The prophets have stopped speaking The king has left the city
cards.verse_text: For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
cards.snippet: For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

cards.card_text: He says the days will come when the city's enemies will barricade it, surround it, hem it in on every side and level it to the ground, the city and the children within its walls, without leaving one stone on another.
cards.verse_text: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
cards.snippet: …upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
